title: 第58章 歌坛新人王夜宿神秘女主
content_zh:
第58章 歌坛新人王夜宿神秘女主-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

糖嫣？

刘施施反应比他还快。

“是那个糖嫣吗？就是那个MV？”

“对。”

“你们应该都看过《体面》MV吧？前段时间不是挺火的？”

蔡怡农故意忽略自家一姐的态度，在她看来，刘施施的反应过于激动。

小丫头片子，沉不住气！！

两个人只是拍了MV，你就这么激动？

要是两人演了对手戏，你岂不是要疯？

作为一个老江湖，她看出来这俩人有猫腻。

如果换做以前，她肯定会棒打鸳鸯，现在魏沐这么火，俩人的恋情对刘施施有好处。

胡哥袁红对视一眼，没有说话，随后纷纷看向魏沐，期待他的表现。

他们两人都比对方年纪大，

但感情这方面，达者为师。

这位上戏学弟不仅在事业上面值得他们学习，感情上更值得学习。

一首《此生不换》追到刘施施，《体面》MV又和糖嫣打得火热。

按理来说，《体面》MV是在6月中旬面世，现在是7月底，热度应该早就过去。

可谁让魏沐的新专辑过于火爆，连带着之前拍的MV焕发第二春。

《体面》《说散就散》《可乐》三首分手神曲，已经成为全国KTV点歌榜的前十名。

这年头去KTV的大部分都是年轻男女，学生和上班族居多。

这类群体感情丰富，喜欢伤春悲秋，魏沐创作出来的三首分手歌曲正好触动了他们敏感的心灵。

其中《体面》凭借其精致的画面以及优秀的故事情节，成为2008年上半年最火爆MV！！

糖嫣莫名其妙火了，就因为拍个MV，这也是蔡怡农考虑选她为女主角的原因之一。

不过这个女主角只是暂时的，毕竟杨蜜那边还没表态。

如果杨蜜愿意过来，女主角就是她的，糖嫣只能让道。

“对，我和她拍过MV，不过她没有跟我说过这件事。”

魏沐神情不变，眼神清明，只是正常回答问题。

“嗯，是我不让她说的。目前公司还没有宣布，我怕出什么变故。”

变故？

魏沐眼底闪过一丝讶然。

不愧是当上唐人老板的人，假话空话章口就来。

人家都通过了，还能有什么变故，难道不是为了刺激大幂幂？

这个时候，杨蜜估计会像热锅上的蚂蚁，急得团团转吧？

“好。我要说的就是这么多，咱们等会吃饭。”

.........

晚上吃完了饭，魏沐和刘施施分别坐车回去。

和以前不一样，自新专辑火爆，他身边就跟着一群狗仔，时刻等着拍照片。

这年头的狗仔比后世疯狂，为了拍上照片无所不用其极。

魏沐倒是无所谓，他不介意恋情曝光，但瞎姐不一样，以她现在的浅薄经验，根本承受不住媒体的长枪短炮。

Tang Yan?

Liu Shishi reacted faster than him.

"Is it that Tang Yan? Is that the MV?"

"Yes."

"You should have all seen the "Decent" MV, right? Wasn't it quite popular some time ago?"

Cai Yinong deliberately ignored the attitude of her first sister. In her opinion, Liu Shishi's reaction was too excited.

The little girl can’t hold back her anger!!

Two people just shot a MV, are you so excited?

If the two of them acted opposite each other, wouldn't you go crazy?

As a veteran, she could see that there was something fishy between these two people.

If it were in the past, she would definitely beat the couple. Now that Wei Mu is so popular, their relationship is good for Liu Shishi.

Brother Hu and Yuan Hong looked at each other without saying anything, and then looked at Wei Mu, looking forward to his performance.

Both of them are older than the other,

But when it comes to feelings, those who have mastered them are the teachers.

This junior theater student is not only worth learning from them in terms of career, but also worth learning emotionally.

The song "Never Change in This Life" caught up with Liu Shishi, and the MV for "Decent" also had a fierce battle with Tang Yan.

Logically speaking, the "Decent" MV was released in mid-June, and it is now the end of July, so the popularity should have passed long ago.

But who made Wei Mu's new album so popular that it also brought a second life to the MV he shot before?

The three breakup songs, "Decent", "Let's Break Up" and "Coke", have become the top ten on the national KTV song list.

Most of the people who go to KTV these days are young men and women, mostly students and office workers.

This kind of group is full of emotions and likes to mourn spring and autumn. The three breakup songs created by Wei Mu just touched their sensitive hearts.

Among them, "Decent" became the most popular MV in the first half of 2008 with its exquisite graphics and excellent storyline!!

Tang Yan became popular inexplicably just because she shot a music video. This is one of the reasons why Cai Yinong considered choosing her as the heroine.

But this heroine is only temporary, after all, Yang Mi has not expressed her position yet.

If Yang Mi is willing to come over, the heroine will be hers, and Tang Yan can only give way.

"Yes, I filmed a music video with her, but she never told me about it."

Wei Mu's expression remained unchanged, his eyes were clear, and he just answered questions normally.

"Well, I didn't let her say it. The company hasn't announced it yet, and I'm afraid something will happen."

An accident?

Wei Mu's eyes flashed with surprise.

He is worthy of being the boss of the Tang Dynasty, and he always talks lies and empty words.

Everyone has passed, so what else can happen? Isn't it just to stimulate the power?

At this time, Yang Mi would probably be like an ant on a hot pot, anxious, right?

"Okay. That's all I have to say. Let's eat later."

.........

After dinner in the evening, Wei Mu and Liu Shishi went back by car respectively.

Unlike before, since the new album became popular, he has been surrounded by a group of paparazzi, always waiting to take photos.

Paparazzi these days are crazier than later generations and will do anything to take photos.

Wei Mu didn't care, he didn't mind the exposure of his love affair, but Blind Sister was different. With her current shallow experience, she couldn't bear the media's criticism.
